data.title: 青山七海 · 寒风车站的共围一条围巾
data.description: 冬夜打工结束后的路灯下雪花轻舞，七海双手呵着白气。当你将红白针织围巾分出一半轻轻绕在她颈间时，马尾少女微微一愣，随即眉眼弯弯，悄悄把冰凉的小手塞进你的大衣口袋。
data.location: snowy winter street corner under a warm streetlamp
data.action: 当你将红白针织围巾分出一半轻轻绕在她颈间时，马尾少女微微一愣，随即眉眼弯弯

data.promptProse: Nanami's chestnut ponytail peeks over the red-and-white scarf as she smiles from the left. At her right a taller, short black-haired man in a navy wool coat shares the other end. Her chilled hand slips into his coat pocket, with both faces lit by the snowy streetlamp.
